items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: It was Sissy Viney, Bud Viney and Daniel Viney.

ctx.x: See then from then on she just raised me right on up. You know, Viney Monroe, because she had two sons and a daughter and they didn't call her by the real name. It was Sissy Viney, Bud Viney and Daniel Viney. They'd call....
